Built against [wamsoft/krkrz_dev](https://github.com/wamsoft/krkrz_dev) V2.6.5

- In the browser and iOS builds the bottoms of g, j, p, q and y (and their shadow) were cut off in the message window
- The browser version, [krkren.github.io/kagex](https://krkren.github.io/kagex/), can be added to a phone's home screen and then opens without the browser's bars. iPhone browsers can't show a web page full screen, so this is the way to play full screen there; on Android, Config > Screen Mode > Full Screen also works (tap once more after choosing it)

Everything in this release is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/krkren/kagex/blob/0.2.2/CHANGELOG.md).

On Windows the engine needs OpenGL ES: a graphics driver that supports it, or ANGLE's `libEGL.dll` and `libGLESv2.dll` next to `krkrz.exe`.

The macOS app isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS blocks it the first time: open it from the context menu (Open), or allow it under System Settings > Privacy & Security. The Android APK is signed with a debug key: allow installs from unknown sources, or use `adb install`. A build for iPhones and iPads needs an Apple Developer account, so iOS is the Simulator only.
